citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi attributes the Shema statement to Sumkhos bar Yosef. The separate Sumkhos entry records the Yosef and Yose witnesses. Render the patronymic explicitly, as the two items under Yosef do not establish that the same father is intended.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Menachot explicitly names Akiva ben Yosef in the report about Moses visiting the future academy. Keep the patronymic independent of Sumkhos’s.
